Name: Lighter's Namecard
Desc: Obtain by unlocking Lighter's Mindscape: Mercenary Leader
Desc2:
A card with the image of Leaps and Bounds Logistics Company's Hollow affairs consultant printed on it.
The edges of the card are charred and burned but luckily don't cover the prices. "Any fighting is guaranteed to be a good show," is also written on it... Is this really proper Hollow consulting?
